outcome.Summary: Fixed three bugs in ledger/ledger.go per the spec in ledger/doc.go: (1) events were applied in file order — now sorted by timestamp, ties by seq, before replay; (2) at-least-once duplicates were applied repeatedly — now a seen-id set counts only the first occurrence of each event id; (3) toUSD truncated float64(amount*rate) — now uses exact integer arithmetic (rates scaled to 1e4: USD 10000, EUR 10825, GBP 12675) with round-half-to-even (banker's rounding). Also enlarged the scanner buffer. Verified: go test ./... passes (both tests), go vet is clean, and an independent Python implementation of the spec using decimal ROUND_HALF_EVEN reproduces testdata/expected_balances.json exactly.
